canonicalJson: keys sorted recursively (UTF-16 code unit order), no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8, strings and numbers as ECMAScript JSON.stringify writes them

keyEncoding.publicKey: raw 32-byte ed25519 public key, base64url, no padding
keyEncoding.keyId: first 32 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the raw 32-byte public key
keyEncoding.seed: private key seed = SHA-256(UTF-8 seedLabel), the 32-byte ed25519 seed (RFC 8032)

actionHash.formula: contentHash("approval" + U+0000 + canonicalJson({argsSha256, aud, tool: <bare tool>})); contentHash(s) = "h2:" + first 16 hex of HMAC-SHA256(key, s), key = HMAC-SHA256(installToken, "moorai/content-hash/v2")

hub.replayKey: the nonce and the approvalId are each single-use: refuse when "nonce:<nonce>" was seen, or when the receipt has an approvalId and "approvalId:<approvalId>" was seen; record both

cases.name: console-approved
cases.note: A person approved the call in the console; the hub skips its queue.

cases.name: console-approved-int-bool-approver
cases.note: Arguments with an integer and a boolean, received in non-canonical key order; argsSha256 is over the canonical JSON of the parsed arguments, never the received bytes. Carries the optional approver pseudonym.

cases.name: helper
cases.note: keySource helper (reserved for the privileged local helper): the hub skips its queue.

cases.name: device-allowed
cases.note: keySource device is advisory (any process of the same OS user can sign with the device key): valid, but the hub queues.

cases.name: non-integer-float
cases.note: hub queues: non-integer number. The receipt is valid, but a float's text form is not reproduced by every canonicalizer.

cases.name: integer-above-2-53
cases.note: hub queues: non-integer number. 9007199254740994 is above 2^53, outside the integers a JSON number in an IEEE double holds exactly.

cases.name: expired
cases.note: exp is before the hub's now.

cases.name: wrong-tool
cases.note: Minted for dissolve_agent, attached to run_command.

cases.name: args-mismatch
cases.note: Minted for one command, the hub received another.

cases.name: model-injected
cases.note: A _moorai receipt written by the model (signed by a key the hub does not pin). MoorAI strips a model-supplied _moorai and replaces it; a hub must still reject it.

cases.name: device-approved
cases.note: keySource device claiming basis approved: refused (a device receipt is always basis allowed).

cases.name: ttl-too-long
cases.note: exp - iat is 121 s; the limit is 120.

cases.name: device-key-claims-console
cases.note: Signed by the device key, payload claims keySource console with basis approved: refused. Trust follows the pinned key's keySource, never the payload's.

cases.name: device-key-claims-helper
cases.note: Signed by the device key, payload claims keySource helper: refused.

cases.name: console-key-basis-allowed
cases.note: Signed by the console key with basis allowed (no approval): valid, but the hub queues; only an approval skips the queue.

cases.name: replay
cases.note: The hub has already seen this nonce (the same receipt presented again).

cases.name: approval-id-reused
cases.note: A second console receipt for the same approval (same approvalId, a new nonce) after the hub accepted the first (the console-approved case): refused. The approvalId and the nonce are each single-use; one approval runs exactly one action.
